topic: Atomic Model History and Subatomic Particles
key_concepts: Atom is the basic unit of matter
Nucleus is the center of the atom
Protons are positively charged, electrons negatively charged, and neutrons neutral
Democritus first proposed indivisible atoms but lacked experimental support
Aristotle's four-element view and rejection delayed atomic theory
Dalton reintroduced atoms in 1808 based on chemical evidence
Dalton's atomic theory states atoms are indivisible, indestructible, and can combine
Laws of conservation of mass, definite proportion, and multiple proportions support atomic
In chemical reactions atoms rearrange but total number remains unchanged
J.J. Thomson discovered electrons and Millikan measured electron charge and mass
Rutherford discovered the nucleus and neutrons were later discovered
Heating increases particle motion and overcomes attraction between particles
